errors.text_span: 右侧的垂直轴标记为“验证集准确率”
errors.evidence: The right vertical axis actually represents accuracy, not '验证集准确率'; the reference mentions '验证集数量'.
The height of the orange bar for '空间推理' was reported incorrectly as 1011; it should be 675.
The description does not mention the units on the left axis (数量) or the correct title for the right axis.
The description does not clarify the purpose of the chart as indicated by the reference.
